text:
eli (FinOps): Flagging a weird invoice delta for us-west2. Reservations show a negative utilization adjustment and some teams got charged reserved amortization even though they used mostly spot. Need a quick audit.

sam (Platform): Hmm, which invoice lines? Can you paste the invoice id or a sample line?

eli (FinOps): invoice_2026-04-USW2 line: SKU: GPU_A100_80GB_reserved_amortization, project: research-gen, amount: $24,300. But usage_raw shows only 120 hours reserved-equivalent for that project.

rita (Research): We ran long experiments in early April but I thought those were all spot. We definitely didn't buy reservations.

billng-bot: Billing export available: gs://redwood-billing/exports/2026-04/invoice_2026-04-usw2.csv (md5: b7c1...).

amelia (CostOps): I'm pulling the usage mapping now. Quick hypothesis: amortization charge was applied against a shared reservation because reservation mapping is to a billing-account-level label and projects without explicit exclusion get assigned amortized cost.

noah (SRE): Also saw a churn where the reserved pool was scaled down on 2026-03-31 and a reconciliation job reallocated amortization on 2026-04-01. Could be timing.

sam (Platform): We recently changed the reservation-owner tag from team=platform to team=infra in org-labels; that would affect amortization allocation. Who changed that?

rita (Research): Not us. Our projects were labeled team=research.

eli (FinOps): Action: Amelia can you output a project-level amortization mapping and show which reservation IDs map to which allocation buckets? Need CSV with columns: reservation_id, allocated_projects, allocated_cost.

amelia (CostOps): Doing it. Also adding the org label diff between Mar31-Apr1.

billing-bot: Reservation allocation dump: gs://redwood-billing/allocations/2026-04/reservations_alloc.json (note: file has redaction).

amelia (CostOps): Quick findings: reservation rsv-34a mapped to billing-account:prod and label team=infra on Apr 1; allocated_projects include research-gen, infra-batch-west, playground-test. research-gen got ~45% of amortized cost due to allocation by usage_hours metric.

eli (FinOps): That explains the charge but not why research-gen shows reserved hours = 120. If allocation used usage_hours, spot usage should not attract reserved amortization. Did the reconcile script mistakenly combine spot+reserved hours?

noah (SRE): The reconcile job uses a normalized metric 'gpu_effective_hours' which multiplies wall_hours by (1 + retry_factor). If research-gen had heavy retry_factor due to preemptions, that could inflate effective hours and therefore allocation share. 03/29-04/02 had high preemptions for that project.

rita (Research): We had two large runs that retried a lot after preemptions. Can we separate out spot vs reserved actual hours in the allocation rule?

sam (Platform): We should. Allocation should prefer reserved-hour metrics only for amortization. Mixing effective hours is a bug. I'll open PLAT-5782 to change the allocation key to reserved_hours when amortization is present.

eli (FinOps): Two tracks: 1) short-term credit request to vendor or internal write-off for research-gen amortization portion if this was a billing allocation bug; 2) fix allocation logic before next invoice. Amelia please prepare the allocation breakdown and a recommended credit memo amount.

amelia (CostOps): CSV ready: gs://redwood-billing/exports/usw2-resv-allocation-april.csv. Recommended provisional credit for research-gen: $18,450 pending code fix and confirmation.

sam (Platform): PLAT-5782 opened. I'll prioritize the hotfix and target deploy by 2026-04-05.

noah (SRE): Also suggests we add an alert: if reservation amortization assigned to a single project > $10k/day then auto-flag for manual review. I can add to oncall runbook.

rita (Research): We appreciate the quick turnaround. If we get the credit that will help the grant budget.

eli (FinOps): Action items recap: Amelia -> submit provisional credit memo draft and CSV (EOD). Sam -> PLAT-5782 hotfix (deploy by 2026-04-05). Noah -> add amortization alert to runbook. Research -> confirm any additional runs that could affect the calculation.

amelia (CostOps): Draft credit memo saved: gs://redwood-billing/requests/research-gen-credit-draft.md. Will request finance approval after Eli signs off.

eli (FinOps): Thanks team. Will review and escalate to finance lead if needed. :+1:
